title: 2035 Prairie, the corner of the limestone row, is built
items: 2035 Prairie, the 21st Street corner of the 1869 limestone row, now stands as a full house in place of its draft. Its plan comes from the 1911 map: a stone front in line with 2033's, a bowed stone bay at the south end, a windowed flank along 21st Street and a two-storey brick range behind. Its entrance comes from the Tribune's 1898 sketch: a round-arched door under a columned porch beside a railed deck, at the top of a swept stoop. Its floors and cornice match 2033's, so the row keeps one roofline.
